title: Making PrEP Easier to Access Through Grindr
summary: Grindr users in the US and Canada can now access free or low-cost PrEP care through Freddie in the Grindr app.
body_markdown:
To our global Grindr community,


**Starting today, Grindr users in the US and Canada can choose to access free or low cost PrEP care through the Grindr app.**


We’re making this possible in partnership with ***Freddie*** , a physician-led telehealth and pharmacy platform that Grindr today announced an agreement to acquire.


PrEP is up to 99% effective at preventing HIV, yet millions of people who could benefit from it aren’t using it. **Through Grindr’s Health center, users can now connect with Freddie to see a clinician, get tested, and have medication delivered discreetly.**


*for illustrative purposes only - this shows the experience we hope to deliver in the near future*


This builds on years of work through[Grindr for Equality](https://www.grindr.com/g4e) and public health partners to expand access to HIV testing and prevention.


Grindr users have ordered more than half a million free HIV self-test kits through our app, with a quarter of recipients reporting they’d never taken an HIV test before. Now, we’re making the next step easier.


**To get started, open Grindr and tap Health.**


George Arison, CEO


***For more information, visit***[www.grindr.com/grindrhealth](http://www.grindr.com/grindrhealth)
